description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2024: Contribution in Study of Soil-Steel Pipe Piles In-Ground Hinge Performance is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Saul Romero, University of Texas at El Paso (utep.edu). My project focuses on the structural behavior of steel pipe piles under different soil conditions, emphasizing the evaluation of the in-ground plastic hinge performance. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-hy0r-sj11. Keywords: NSF NHERI UCSD LHPOST6, Soil Pit,  Steel Pipe Piles,  Plastic Hinge,  Soil Conditions . Published 2024-08-21. Facility named: Six Degree of Freedom Large High-Performance Outdoor Shake Table (LHPOST6) - University of California, San Diego. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
